title: Root Equals Sum of Children
goal: Check whether a three-node tree root equals the sum of its children.
strategy: Read both child values, add them, and compare the result with the root. The condition concerns the child sum, not equality with either child separately.

edgeCases: A near match still fails exact equality
Signed children may cancel to a zero root
A negative root can equal two negative children
